stackwalker-concept.title: Inspect stack frames with StackWalker
stackwalker-concept.short: Traverse stack frames through the standard API
stackwalker-concept.summary: StackWalker provides lazy, configurable access to the current thread's stack frames.
stackwalker-concept.why: It avoids eagerly materializing an entire stack trace when only selected frame information is needed.
stackwalker-concept.tips: Request only the StackWalker options required by the diagnostic task.

threadlocal-concept.title: Keep per-thread state with ThreadLocal
threadlocal-concept.short: Associate a value with each thread
threadlocal-concept.summary: ThreadLocal gives each accessing thread an independently stored value.
threadlocal-concept.why: It can isolate legacy thread-confined context, but values must be cleaned up carefully in pooled threads.
threadlocal-concept.tips: Prefer explicit context passing or ScopedValue where appropriate; call remove when pooled threads retain ThreadLocal state.

files-mismatch.title: Find the first difference between files
files-mismatch.short: Use Files.mismatch to compare file contents
files-mismatch.summary: Files.mismatch returns the position of the first differing byte, or -1 when files have equal content.
files-mismatch.why: It expresses file comparison directly without manually opening and walking byte buffers.
files-mismatch.tips: Treat -1 as equal content; file metadata can still differ.

collections-ncopies.title: Create repeated list elements
collections-ncopies.short: Use Collections.nCopies for a fixed repeated value
collections-ncopies.summary: Collections.nCopies returns an immutable list containing the requested number of references to one object.
collections-ncopies.why: It is concise for repeated constants and padding values.
collections-ncopies.tips: All positions refer to the same supplied object, which matters when that object is mutable.

not-yet-bound-exception.title: NotYetBoundException
not-yet-bound-exception.short: Bind a datagram channel before receiving
not-yet-bound-exception.summary: Some datagram channel operations require the channel to have a local address first.
not-yet-bound-exception.why: Receiving needs a bound local endpoint on which datagrams can arrive.
not-yet-bound-exception.tips: Call bind before receive when the channel has not been implicitly bound.

closed-selector-exception.title: ClosedSelectorException
closed-selector-exception.short: Do not select after closing a Selector
closed-selector-exception.summary: Selector operations fail with ClosedSelectorException after the selector has been closed.
closed-selector-exception.why: Closing releases selector resources and permanently ends its selection lifecycle.
closed-selector-exception.tips: Keep selection inside the selector's resource lifetime and coordinate shutdown with the selecting thread.

generic-throwable-subclass-error.title: Generic class cannot extend Throwable
generic-throwable-subclass-error.summary: Java forbids a generic class from directly or indirectly extending Throwable.
generic-throwable-subclass-error.why: Exception handling identifies catchable types at runtime, while generic type arguments are erased.
generic-throwable-subclass-error.tips: Keep the exception class non-generic and store any needed context in ordinary fields or a non-generic payload type.

generic-class-literal-error.title: Parameterized type in a class literal
generic-class-literal-error.summary: Java does not allow a class literal such as List<String>.class because generic type arguments are erased.
generic-class-literal-error.why: At runtime there is a List class object, not a distinct class object for each type argument.
generic-class-literal-error.tips: Use List.class and carry generic type information separately when reflection needs it.

serial-lint-warning.title: Serialization lint warning
serial-lint-warning.summary: javac's serial lint category reports suspicious declarations in serializable classes, including missing serialVersionUID in relevant cases.
serial-lint-warning.why: Serialization compatibility depends on class structure and explicit versioning makes that contract visible.
serial-lint-warning.tips: Add an intentional serialVersionUID when Java serialization is actually part of the design.

bigdecimal-scale-equals-trap.title: BigDecimal.equals includes scale
bigdecimal-scale-equals-trap.short: Use compareTo when numeric equality should ignore scale
bigdecimal-scale-equals-trap.summary: BigDecimal.equals considers both value and scale, so 1.0 and 1.00 are not equal by equals.
bigdecimal-scale-equals-trap.why: BigDecimal preserves representation details that participate in equals and hashCode.
bigdecimal-scale-equals-trap.tips: Use compareTo == 0 for numeric equivalence, but keep equals when representation-sensitive identity is intended.
